## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Developer Checklist

- [ ] Added/updated unit tests for the changes
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass locally (`make test`)
- [ ] Code passes all linting checks (`make lint`)
- [ ] Properly handled errors and added appropriate logging
- [ ] Run `make tidy` to clean up dependencies
